Good fish and chips, strange new owners.
Jan 2025 • Couples
We ate here once on our trip to Vung Tau. We both had fish and chips and it was very good. I rate it 3/5 as we were served by an American(?) man who identified himself as the new owner. To be honest, I think he’d been drinking the afternoon away with his mates, who were sitting at a table near us. He was a pleasant enough guy, but obviously a little worse for wear, and we were privy to his table’s fairly loud chatter and phone calls to their girlfriends. There were no staff serving on the floor and the new owner had to get the chef from the kitchen to make me a lemon juice. We were a bit dubious, but the fish and chips were excellent. I hope the new owners do not lose their chef, who is obviously a hard-working gem, and that they are able to employ some capable staff to work the bar and the floor. Otherwise, I can see this place going downhill quickly. Please new owners, lift your game and employ some front of house staff who know what they are doing and can make customers feel welcome.
